name: Lyle Griffin Warshauer
tagline: Top rated Medical Malpractice attorney in Atlanta, Georgia
education: Samford University Cumberland School of Law
about: As a Senior Partner and Co-founder of Warshauer Woodward Atkins, LLP in Atlanta, Georgia, Attorney Lyle Griffin Warshauer has devoted her career to aggressively representing clients who have been severely injured due to the carelessness of others, primarily related to medical negligence. Lyle manages the medical malpractice team at the firm, and has achieved success in a wide variety of medical malpractice actions, including those involving surgical errors, misdiagnosis, medication errors and birth injury. She prides herself on taking complex cases that require hard work and creativity. She obtained a record verdict for a medical malpractice case in her first medical malpractice trial, and has continued to obtain significant recoveries for her clients and their families ever since.

Lyle’s success has been recognized by her peers in the legal community as well. In addition to her Super Lawyer status, Top 100 Georgia and Top 50 Georgia Women Lawyers rankings, she has received an AV Preeminent rating through Martindale-Hubbell, signifying the highest level of professional excellence. Lyle is a leader in her profession, with her long-standing service to the Georgia Trial Lawyers Association. She is a recipient of the Association’s Guardian of Justice Award, and is a President-President (2020-2021). She is also a member of the American Association for Justice, and is a regular participant in AAJ’s Birth Trauma and Medical Negligence Groups.

Known for her constant pursuit of excellence, Lyle is equally at home writing sophisticated legal briefs or going up against a large corporation. Through her decades of practice, Lyle has become known as a gifted legal writer and strategist. She is a passionate trial lawyer, constitutional scholar, and a highly-regarded appellate advocate. Lyle frequently speaks on a variety of legal topics, both locally and nationally, and is often quoted in the news media.

Lyle is admitted to practice law in Georgia, Alabama and Tennessee, and frequently assists in the management of cases throughout the southeast. In addition to her trial work with Warshauer Woodward Atkins, Lyle is also mediating cases with Henning Mediation & Arbitration, and is available to work with attorneys to resolve civil cases throughout Georgia.
